summary: A humorous feature on 'Tinker Town', a local maker space established September 14, 2023, and the growing popularity of maker spaces in the city. It profiles founder Mariana Vortex and members who invent, take classes, and build community, and it argues that maker spaces incubate start-ups and bridge socioeconomic divides.
one_line: A playful profile of the Tinker Town maker space showing how shared tools, classes and community foster local invention, start-ups and inclusion.
key_facts: Tinker Town is a local maker space established on September 14, 2023.
Mariana Vortex, an engineer by training, is the founder of Tinker Town and is called the 'Maker Maestro' by community consensus.
A fridge-sized 3D printer at Tinker Town once printed a full-sized, functional kayak.
Barry Boltz, a regular patron, began with an obsession with sustainable cutlery (a reusable straw) and moved on to inventing a self-cleaning fork.
Cally Hacksaw, Tinker Town's education coordinator, described a drone-building workshop held last Thursday, with drones that could deliver pizzas.
The drone workshop is still working out the 'toppings displacement ratio', since pepperoni can be quite aerodynamic.
Lucy Lumen, a part-time electrician, compares the maker community to the Knights of the Round Table, with soldering irons and 3D pens instead of swords.
A not-yet-peer-reviewed study by statistician Dr. Hertz SoGood suggests start-ups emerging from maker spaces have an advantage in entrepreneurship.
Dr. So Good credits access to tools, collective brainpower and a 'petri dish of creativity' for this effect.
The article says maker spaces bridge socioeconomic divides: 'your ideas, not your tax bracket, are your currency'.
Jimmy 'the Jigsaw' McLaren built an eco-friendly lawnmower called the 'Lawn GONEcycle' from old bicycle parts at Tinker Town, for 'three nickels and pure gumption'.
Maker spaces are found in garages, abandoned warehouses and shopping areas.
Vortex says 'We've only just begun' while cleaning a sensor that may one day revolutionize recycling.
